scope: Code quality review of six performance changes; no commit, install or publish.
head: a4e252e5c36b3c05eaaff88a90d445434cf50def

findings.resolution: One canonical preparation flow owns optional target size and fallback. Cancellation propagates without a separate flag.
Typed times and CGImage rasters replace recursive KVC/content inspection and unsafeDowncast. Renderer extracted from subtitle settings.
One admission loop for initial and replacement tasks. Cancelled groups refuse admission and workers check cancellation before calling the provider.

verification.gui: Interactive post-resize and visible-subtitle repetition remains unverified; prior Mac lock limitation unchanged.

captions.comparison: Five alternating pairs per phase and resolution, frozen optimized implementation before review versus reviewed implementation. Golden pixels and export probes identical. Speed and RSS remain similar; no new export speed gain claimed.

windows.comparison: Five alternating pairs with the frozen batching reference; local delays and arithmetic, no external provider.

exportResolution.comparison: Repeated all 24 strict legacy acceptance cases after review. Pixel/geometry incompatibilities unchanged. Product gate remains false. Speed pairs from the earlier performance experiment were not rerun.
